author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
⭐ Try Granola FREE for one month - https://go.granola.ai/kevin-stratvert
Granola is the AI assistant that will work with any meeting platform, and it now supports direct linking to your Microsoft 365 calendar, so you can see your Outlook appointments, get reminders, and start meeting transcriptions directly from Granola. 

Granola transcribes audio during meetings, so it can be used with Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and other meeting platforms. You can get help from the Granola AI during a meeting to get caught up or ask specific questions. And the assistant will organize your notes and answer your questions after the meeting ends.

What you’ll learn:
• Link your Microsoft or Google Workspace account to Granola
• Take notes before a meeting starts
• Use Granola’s automatic meeting transcription
• Get answers and support from Granola’s AI during and after a meeting
• Use Granola with different meeting platforms, including Teams and Google Meet
• Use Granola for in-person meeting
title: The Ultimate AI Assistant for Any Online Meeting | Granola
